Example

From a few sentences to a hiring kit.

A made-up example, shortened to three interview questions.

What you enter

“Part-time front counter person for our dry cleaning shop. Handles drop-offs and pickups, the register, and phone calls. Weekends required.”

What you get
Interview questions
  • Tell me about a time a customer was upset about something that wasn't your fault. What did you do?
  • How do you keep track of details when the counter gets busy?
  • Our busiest days are Saturdays. How does a weekend schedule fit with your other commitments?

Example only, shortened. Real results depend on what you enter.

How it works

Three steps.

  1. Describe the position

    A few sentences about the job, the hours and what matters most.

  2. Get your hiring kit

    The summary, questions, criteria, red flags and onboarding tips appear together.

  3. Use it in the interview

    Print it, keep it on your phone, or email yourself a copy.

FAQ

Common questions.

Do I need HR experience?
No. It's built for owners and managers who hire a few times a year and want to be prepared, without an HR department.
Can I write the job posting too?
Yes — that's the Job Description Writer, another Workblox Business tool.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Hiring Manager is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
